cases.objective: Home → plan → exercise → Manual Guidance session → summary → the planned exercise is recorded as completed (Modules 4 → 5 → 4)
cases.input: Test user (6 days a week); Workout tab → training day (today, or the first training day when today is a rest day) → its quickest repetition exercise → Start exercise → Manual Guidance → "Completed ✓" for every set (rest timers run) → Finish → Back to Workout Plan
cases.expected: Summary "Confirmed N reps" with N = sets × reps; target reached; session saved with its plan link; plan progress records the entry as done
cases.actual: Monday (today is a rest day): Bodyweight Squat 3×12 (entry 1, plan link 0/1); summary opened by itself after the last set, label "Confirmed 36 reps" 1; target reached true; saved with plan link true (in memory); plan progress done true
cases.test: ATC-DEV-INT-01 Home → plan → exercise → Manual Guidance session → summary → the planned exercise is recorded as completed (Modules 4 → 5 → 4)

cases.objective: During a live camera session the voice assistant answers from that session and the session continues (Modules 5 ↔ 6)
cases.input: Planned camera exercise → consent → Continue → menu "Ask Baymax (voice)" → chip "How many reps?" → close
cases.expected: Reply states the camera counter's reps for that exercise; after closing, the camera session is still active
cases.actual: Blocked: camera permission for the installed test build is "denied" on the phone (a reinstall resets it); the tests do not grant permissions. Allow Camera for Baymax in Android Settings and rerun
cases.test: ATC-DEV-INT-02 During a live camera session the voice assistant answers from that session and the session continues (Modules 5 ↔ 6)

cases.objective: The voice chip "Pause workout" pauses the running posture session (Module 6 → 5)
cases.input: Planned exercise → Manual Guidance → "Ask Baymax" → chip "How many reps?" → chip "Pause workout" → close
cases.expected: Session paused; the guidance screen shows "Resume"
cases.test: ATC-DEV-INT-03 The voice chip "Pause workout" pauses the running posture session (Module 6 → 5)
